summary.text: Chuck Wichgers is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 84 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election (Ballotpedia lists no other candidate in the general election).
Ballotpedia lists his profession as sales.

paragraphs.text: Chuck Wichgers was born in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, graduated from Muskego High School in 1983 and earned an associate degree from Waukesha County Technical College in 1985.
His career experience includes working in professional sales.
He was elected to the City of Muskego Common Council and the Waukesha County Board of Supervisors, both in 1999.
Ballotpedia gives Wichgers's Assembly tenure as beginning in 2017.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Constitution and Ethics (chair), Forestry, Parks, and Outdoor Recreation, Health, and Regulatory Licensing Reform (vice-chair).
